description: This file contains a test suite for the HelloWorld Vue component using the Vitest testing framework. It tests whether the component renders correctly with a given message.

methods.name: rendering test for HelloWorld
methods.description: Test to verify that the HelloWorld component renders the message passed as a prop.

ctags.name: wrapper
ctags.pattern: /^    const wrapper = mount(HelloWorld, { props: { msg: 'Hello Vitest' } })$/
